text: Entry 2036 replaces a nightly test appeal with four 2025 donation_tab schedules and supplies the same JSON to beta and release branding. It removes the nightly-only channel include and locale exclusion. OfflineNotifications reads the resource at chrome://branding/content/inAppNotificationData.json; the filter still applies policy, parsed start/end times, percentage and optional profile includes/excludes. percent_chance:100 does not bypass the other checks. Frozen release data has 2026 schedules, so 2025 dates are historical examples. The offline-data test checks required fields, parseable start times, a future end time and ID-set membership; it does not run a full schema validator or simulate every date boundary. Static source and test inspection only. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending-single-browser-reader.
title: Shipped notification schedules belong to each branding resource
